title: KestrelCare Terms: Deductible on Remainder Authorizations and Maintained Vehicles
content:
**Article.** The deductible taken from the starting amount of a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts remainder authorization is set as follows:

1. where the Kestrel limited warranty decision approved the repair order and applied a deductible of its own, no plan deductible is taken;
2. where that is not the case and the holder has an active KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans plan with at least 1 service visit redeemed in the last twelve months, the maintained-holder share of the plan's chosen deductible is taken, that share being 50 percent (0.5);
3. otherwise the plan's chosen deductible is taken.

The maintenance condition is read from the holder's KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans records: the plan's status (active) and its visit-redeemed entries dated within the last twelve months.

## Combinations

| Limited warranty approved with its own deductible | Active KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans plan | Visits redeemed in the last twelve months | Deductible taken |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | any | any | none |
| no | yes | 1 or more | 50 percent of the chosen deductible |
| no | yes | 0 | the chosen deductible |
| no | no (none, or not active) | any | the chosen deductible |

## Figures (hypothetical plans)

| Chosen deductible | Maintained-holder deductible (50 percent) |
|---|---|
| 250.00 | 125.00 |
| 100.00 | 50.00 |
| 0.00 | 0.00 |

A holder whose maintenance plan is fulfilled or expired does not hold an active plan, whatever visits it shows.
